claims: The Baltimore Orioles opened the 2026 MLB season with a 2-1 victory over the Minnesota Twins on Thursday, March 26, 2026, at Camden Yards.
Trevor Rogers threw seven shutout innings.
The game marked the earliest Opening Day in franchise history.
Trevor Rogers was the winning pitcher (1-0).
Colton Cowser provided RBI in the 7th inning.
Blaze Alexander provided RBI in the 7th inning.
Pete Alonso played his first game as an Oriole at first base.
There was a sellout crowd at Oriole Park at Camden Yards.
Reliever Jackson Kowar was sent to Triple-A Norfolk after clearing waivers.
Infielder Bryan Ramos was sent to Triple-A Norfolk after clearing waivers.
Lefty Keegan Akin was placed on the 15-day injured list with a groin strain.
Outfielder Dylan Beavers made the opening roster.
Pre-game ceremonies included a 109-year-old veteran throwing out the first pitch.
Events were held around downtown Baltimore, including at Pickles Pub and the Pratt Street Ale House.
